scope: Retail work items 1-5: store stock, product brands, custom variants, barcode intake and POS

implementation.brands: Company-owned product brands and product links, separate from operational store brands; duplicate-name reuse and audit
implementation.options: Up to five custom dimensions, e.g. flavor, color, size; create one sellable combination per save, append to an existing variant family, independent generated SKU/barcode/price/cost/image
implementation.intake: New product or variant, append variant, exact existing-variant receipt; signed Retail branch/brand, atomic stock plus audit, stable retry receipt, no automatic conversion of existing products
implementation.stock: Store branch only, excludes configured central locations and other store-brand mappings even for wildcard operators; central-only permission cannot receive; no base stock for newly created variant families
implementation.pos: Product-brand labels and search, choose variant or scan exact variant, per-variant cart identity and authoritative price, store stock, mobile/tablet/desktop form; sale rejects variant-parent-only lines

verification.backend_integration: Passed in a disposable PostgreSQL container with network disabled, using schema-only UAT snapshot and synthetic data; test container removed after execution
integration_checks: Migration upgrade/downgrade/upgrade on empty disposable schema
Concurrent idempotent intake, duplicate code, fingerprint mismatch, image/stock failure rollback
Create/append/receive variants, duplicate option combination and dimension mismatch rejection
Variant lookup, brand search, family chooser and authoritative variant prices
Open cashier shift and complete synthetic cash sale: only selected variant balance decreases; no parent balance; parent-only sale rejected
verification.browser: 6 distinct targeted Playwright scenarios passed across the focused runs: existing simple intake, new brand/color-size product, append family, existing variant retry, POS choose/scan with different prices, existing desktop/tablet workspace regression

deployment_requirements.migration: Retail boundary only: retailcatalog0009 after wp84retail0008. Do not upgrade unrelated legacy/restaurant heads.
deployment_requirements.sequence: Backup Retail data, verify store/central location mappings, apply additive Retail migration, deploy backend then frontend, targeted UAT smoke
deployment_requirements.source_drift: UAT includes unrelated server-only changes. Apply this feature onto the reviewed deployed baseline; do not replace with the entire local checkout blindly.
deployment_requirements.rollback: Revert application images first and retain the additive tables and recorded transactions. Downgrade drops product-brand links and must not be used after real data entry without a separate approved recovery plan.

deferred: Work item 7: expanded returns, document and reporting acceptance
Work item 8: UAT seed, commit/push and deployment
Bulk combination creation and automatic conversion of stocked simple products are not enabled
Physical camera, barcode hardware, printing and customer UAT
